name: Ultegra / 105 press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 63 g for the exact SM-BB72-41B HOLLOWTECH II press-fit bottom-bracket assembly, independently listed in the Ultegra and 105 spreads. Threaded SM-BBR60 and other press-fit models retain separate references.
